pages.title: Kobolds
text: Kobolds live wherever there is something worth digging, and they do not share it.

pages.title: Two kinds
text: Both rise in the dark day or night, one or two at a time. A kobold has **21 health** and **2 armour**, is quick, and hits for **4**.

pages.title: Ridge Kobold
text: A small upright lizard-dog of a miner, with a pick and a lamp on its helmet, found in the dark caves under the Glimmer Ridge.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Raw Copper and up to 1 Coal.

pages.title: Geode Kobold
text: A kobold grown over with crystal, carrying a crystal-tipped spear, found in the dark caves under the Crystal Fields.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Amethyst Shards and up to 2 Lapis Lazuli.

pages.title: What they give
text: A Ridge Kobold drops **1 to 2 Kobold Scales**, a Geode Kobold **1 to 2 Kobold Horns**, more with Looting. Both are Hound reagents: see [reagents](reagents).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting.
